import numpy as np

# --- Reasoning ---
# Hammer lies along Y (handle toward +Y, head toward -Y). Both arms grasp from above with
# fingers opening along X so they close across the handle. Keep the hammer aligned along Y
# during handover so the two grippers are spaced along the handle (Y) and don't collide.
# Arm0 grasps slightly toward the head side of the handle midpoint, Arm1 grasps toward the
# +Y end of the handle; center spacing 0.10 m along Y gives a safe buffer.
# Handover near x midpoint of the two grippers (~0.81) at z = 0.18 (within 0.15-0.20).

Q0_DOWN_X = np.array([0.0, 0.707, 0.707, 0.0])    # arm0 facing down, opening along X
Q1_DOWN_X = np.array([0.0, -0.707, 0.707, 0.0])   # arm1 facing down, opening along X (90deg about Z from [0,0,1,0])

hammer_pos, _ = get_hammer_pose()
hx, hy, hz = float(hammer_pos[0]), float(hammer_pos[1]), float(hammer_pos[2])

HANDOVER_X = (0.44 + 1.18) / 2.0   # ~0.81
HANDOVER_Z = 0.18
SAFE_Z = 0.30
ARM0_Y_OFFSET = -0.04   # arm0 grasp point: toward hammer head side of handle midpoint
ARM1_Y_OFFSET = 0.06    # arm1 grasp point: toward free end of handle

# --- Arm1: move out of the way first (high and on its own side) ---
open_gripper_arm1()
goto_pose_arm1(np.array([1.05, hy + ARM1_Y_OFFSET, SAFE_Z + 0.05]), Q1_DOWN_X)

# --- Arm0: grasp the hammer handle ---
open_gripper_arm0()
grasp0 = np.array([hx, hy + ARM0_Y_OFFSET, hz])
goto_pose_arm0(grasp0, Q0_DOWN_X, z_approach=0.12)
close_gripper_arm0()

# Lift straight up first (pure translation), then translate to handover position at safe height
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([hx, hy + ARM0_Y_OFFSET, SAFE_Z]), Q0_DOWN_X)
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([HANDOVER_X, hy + ARM0_Y_OFFSET, SAFE_Z]), Q0_DOWN_X)
# Lower to handover height
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([HANDOVER_X, hy + ARM0_Y_OFFSET, HANDOVER_Z]), Q0_DOWN_X)

# --- Arm1: approach the handle from above and grasp it ---
# Pre-position directly above the grasp point, then descend vertically.
goto_pose_arm1(np.array([HANDOVER_X, hy + ARM1_Y_OFFSET, SAFE_Z + 0.05]), Q1_DOWN_X)
goto_pose_arm1(np.array([HANDOVER_X, hy + ARM1_Y_OFFSET, HANDOVER_Z]), Q1_DOWN_X, z_approach=0.10)
close_gripper_arm1()

# --- Arm0: release and retreat straight up, then back toward its own side ---
open_gripper_arm0()
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([HANDOVER_X, hy + ARM0_Y_OFFSET, SAFE_Z + 0.05]), Q0_DOWN_X)
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([0.50, hy + ARM0_Y_OFFSET, SAFE_Z + 0.05]), Q0_DOWN_X)
